sources.title: haihengh/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-125B-finch-4bit-ple2bit · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-125B — FinchMoE 2-bit routed experts (ple2bit) A FinchMoE install of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-125B (a 48-layer MoE, 512 experts) repacked into the .finch format for SSD-streaming inference on memory-constrained Apple Silicon. Everything is int4/int8 affine, with the routed experts at int2 (four values per byte, group-64 affine, BF16 scale+bias).

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next — open 125B MoE with 6B… | Blog Network
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is an open-weights 125B mixture-of-experts model that activates only 6B parameters per token and previews the Qwen4 architecture. It scores 62.5 on SWE-bench Pro, against 53.4 for Claude-Opus-4.6 (Max).

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next — open 125B MoE with 6B… | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: The model has 125B total parameters but activates 6B per token, plus 51B of n-gram embedding parameters and a 4B multi-token-prediction head. Qwen ships it as an early look at the Qwen4 architecture so the community can prepare for the full Qwen4 family.
